name: io.github.DirtyReal/delv-mcp
title: Delv
description: Search Delv's directory of AI tools, MCP servers, Agent Skills and agents. No API key.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Delv's directory of AI tools (apps, platforms and services, more than 2,000 listed) by keyword, category or pricing. Returns the matching listings, best match first, each with a one-line description, its category, its pricing type and a link to the full listing. For questions about AI apps and products.

query.description: What to look for: a name, a job or a few keywords, such as "video editing" or "transcription". Optional when a category is given.

category.description: Only tools filed under this category.

pricing.description: Only tools with this pricing type. FREEMIUM means a free plan or a free allowance that renews.

has_free_plan.description: Only tools that can be used without paying (pricing type FREE or FREEMIUM).

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: search_mcps
tools.description: Search Delv's directory of MCP servers by keyword, category or supported client. Returns the matching listings, best match first, each with a one-line description, who maintains it, its install command, the clients it lists as supported and how recently its repository changed. Servers archived by their maintainers come last and say so. For questions about MCP servers and connecting assistants to other software.

query.description: What to look for: a product or a job, such as "postgres" or "browser automation". Optional when a category or host is given.

host.description: Only servers whose listing names this client as supported.

official_only.description: Only servers maintained by the product's own maker or by Anthropic.

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_mcp
tools.description: Get one MCP server's full listing from Delv by its slug: the write-up, getting-started steps, install command, config snippet, environment variables, strengths, things to check, and how recently its repository changed. Says how the write-up was made and whether the server has been archived.

slug.description: The server's slug as returned by search_mcps, such as "filesystem" or "supabase".

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search Delv's directory of Agent Skills (Anthropic's own and community collections) by keyword or category. Returns the matching listings, best match first, each with a one-line description, its author and links. For questions about Skills and extending what an agent can do.

query.description: What to look for, such as "pdf" or "spreadsheets". Optional when a category is given.

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search Delv's directory of autonomous AI agents (coding agents, app builders, research and browser agents) by keyword or kind. Returns the matching listings, best match first, each with a one-line description, its maker, the platforms it runs on and its pricing type. For questions about agents that carry out a task by themselves.

query.description: What to look for: a name or a job, such as "app builder". Optional when a kind is given.

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: search_mcp_clients
tools.description: Search Delv's directory of MCP clients: the editors, chat apps, command-line tools and frameworks that can connect to MCP servers. Returns the matching listings, best match first, each with a one-line description and which parts of MCP it supports (tools, resources, prompts). For questions about which app to use MCP servers from.

query.description: What to look for, such as "cursor" or "claude". Optional when a kind is given.

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_pulse
tools.description: Read Delv Pulse, Delv's archive of short AI news summaries (model releases, MCP servers, Skills, developer tools). Pulse stopped publishing in May 2026, so this returns the most recent stories on file, newest first, each with its date and a link to the source. It is an archive, not current news.

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, at most 50).

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one AI tool's full listing from Delv by its slug: what it does, its pricing type and pricing details, strengths, things to check, use cases, alternatives and the write-up. Says how the write-up was made and whether the tool has been discontinued.

slug.description: The tool's slug as returned by search_tools, such as "cursor" or "midjourney".

tools.name: get_safety
tools.description: Get Delv's safety notes for an MCP server, Agent Skill, agent or MCP client: an overall grade (A+ to F), scores for maintainer, permissions, supply chain, transparency and incident history, the red and green flags behind the grade, the permissions it needs and the date the notes were written. The notes were drafted with AI from public information. They are not a security audit.

type.description: Which directory the slug belongs to.

slug.description: The listing's slug as returned by a search, such as "filesystem".

tools.name: get_compatibility
tools.description: Check an MCP server against an MCP client. Returns Delv's record for the pair when there is one (WORKS, PARTIAL or BROKEN, where the record comes from, and notes and a test date when known). When there is no record, says whether the server's own listing names that client as supported, which is a claim and not a test.

server.description: The MCP server's slug as returned by search_mcps, such as "filesystem".

client.description: The MCP client's slug as returned by search_mcp_clients, such as "claude-desktop" or "cursor".

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Get how actively an MCP server, Agent Skill, agent or MCP client is maintained, read from its public repository: the date of the last commit, an activity status by that date (ACTIVE under 30 days, SLOW under 90, STALE under 180, ABANDONED beyond), open issues, whether its maintainers have archived it, and the date Delv last looked. A listing with no public repository has no figures.

type.description: Which directory the slug belongs to.

slug.description: The listing's slug as returned by a search, such as "github-official".
